name: Feature-metric Bundle Adjustment Pose Estimation
definition: A pose estimation method that optimizes relative pose {R, t} by minimizing feature residuals between consecutive frames, using learned high-level features instead of raw RGB pixels to improve robustness against illumination and viewpoint changes.
summary: Feature-metric Bundle Adjustment Pose Estimation optimizes relative pose by minimizing feature residuals between frames, using learned semantic features instead of raw pixels to improve robustness against illumination and viewpoint changes.
